owners.description: List of owning positions in descending order (first has the most priority to control this group)

fir.description: Will lookup position from some other FIR

id.description: Position ID. Defaults to current FIR or global division positions

positions.description: Positions in current FIR that are owned by this group. Group is always on the last priority for each sector in specified positions. No position can have more than 2 groups
